Third-party files the Auto-edit live preview inlines into its sandboxed
graphics iframes (they can't load anything from the network):

- gsap-3.14.2.min.js: GSAP 3.14.2, (c) GreenSock, under the GSAP Standard
  License (https://gsap.com/standard-license). The same build the render
  worker uses (lib/auto-edit/toolchain.ts).
- InterVariable-4.1.woff2: Inter 4.1 by Rasmus Andersson, SIL Open Font
  License 1.1 (Inter-LICENSE.txt).
